title: Great Pyramid sulfuric acid and central pyramid hydrochloric acid from salt

tellings.quote: So the great pyramid was producing sulfuric acid. That sulfuric acid was utilized inside of the central pyramid reacted with salt to create hydrochloric acid.

plain: A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, on a 2026 episode of Jesse Michels's podcast titled with his claim that an alien gave him the true purpose of the pyramids, says the Great Pyramid at Giza was producing sulfuric acid. He says that acid was carried into the central pyramid of the Giza group, where it reacted with salt to make hydrochloric acid. If true, the pyramids would have been a kind of chemical factory rather than simple monuments.
